programme.title: Semifinals 2
programme.desc: Step into the heart of innovation at Hero City Silicon Valley as 'Meet the Drapers' brings you the intense semifinals! Join the renowned Draper family Bill, Tim, Polly, and Adam as they assess 13 dynamic startups competing fiercely for just three coveted spots in the upcoming finals. With anticipation running high, witness the thrilling journey of these startups as they vie for recognition and a chance to make it to the grand finale.

programme.title: Can a Product Aimed at Classrooms Turn a Profit? Part 2
programme.desc: How many times have you been told that will never work? Probably not as often as Netflix co-founder Marc Randolph. The veteran Silicon Valley entrepreneur, advisor, investor, speaker, and best-selling author has founded or co-founded half-a-dozen successful startups and mentored scores of entrepreneurs from first-time business owners to established CEOs. Be a fly on the boardroom wall as Marc's podcast opens up the opportunity for entrepreneurs everywhere to gain the benefit of his years of experience as he helps each guest think through their business problems. How do you support entrepreneurial spirit in your child? Thats what Marc explores in this weeks episode with the help of the first ever quartet of co-founders to appear on the show. Elementary schoolers Julianne, Zachary, Maxfield and Mark have created beverage brand Astronade and caught Marcs attention with their plucky marketing plan that even wound in their local mayor.

programme.title: Super Coffee: How to Scale Culture in a Family Business
programme.desc: Jordan DeCicco created Super Coffee in his dorm room when he was only 19 years old. He dropped out of college to go full-time on his side-hustle and now, together with his two brothers runs the bottled beverage brand out of Austin, Texas. With an impressive $125m in annual revenue, the DeCiccos have attracted big name investors including J. Lo and Alex Rodriguez. Their next step is tackling how to scale - not just domestically but also internationally.

programme.title: Bulu, Inc.
programme.desc: Bulu Box was the sixth company on the subscription box scene. They now focus on private-label subscription boxes for companies of all sizes. Paul and Stephanie Jarrett walk us through how they've led the way and changed the game in this new category.

programme.title: Profitability Tips With Lamar Tyler
programme.desc: Lamar Tyler gives incredibly valuable tips on how to increase profit in business. These are tips that can genuinely change your business for the better. Focus on the customers that you already have. How can you increase the average amount they spend, and increase their customer lifetime value? Too many entrepreneurs go after new customers rather than retaining old ones.

programme.title: Edible Selfies, Extreme Beer Pong and More!
programme.desc: On our fast-paced pitch show, entrepreneurs seek investment from judges. The panel gets pitched a wide variety of items -- everything from fitness gear to edible selfies to an organic toilet bowl cleaner.

programme.title: How To Increase Product Sales Through Community With Lamar Tyler
programme.desc: Lamar Tyler is back, discussing building community, sales, customer retention, and surrounding yourself with winners. He's passionate about reshaping the face of entrepreneurship in the African American community and helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. His advice? Before getting a coach, its good to do your research first.

programme.title: Edible Selfies, Extreme Beer Pong and More!
programme.desc: On our fast-paced pitch show, entrepreneurs seek investment from judges. The panel gets pitched a wide variety of items -- everything from fitness gear to edible selfies to an organic toilet bowl cleaner.

programme.title: From Psychedelics to a $28m+ Business Empire to New York Times Best Seller
programme.desc: Aubrey Marcus is the founder and CEO of Onnit, a lifestyle brand based on a holistic health philosophy he calls Total Human Optimization. Since its founding, Onnit has become an Inc. 500 company and industry leader with over 250 products ranging from peak performance supplements to foods, fitness equipment, and apparel. Inspired by his lifelong experience as a multisport athlete as well as his background in ancient philosophy his goal was to create a company that empowered customers to achieve their fullest human potential. With the launch of the firms flagship supplement Alpha BRAIN in 2011, Onnit was born.

programme.title: From State Pen to Y Combinator Graduate to Mega-Million Dollar Business
programme.desc: Frederick is the CEO and founder of Pigeonly, a low-cost communication and financial services platform that makes it easy for people to support an incarcerated loved one. He came up with the idea after serving time in the Federal Penitentiary for distributing 3,000 kg of weed. Hutson leads a growing team of over 20 people from their Las Vegas headquarters and has raised over $5MM in funding from investors.

programme.title: Digital Music, Robots, Cyber Crime, & Art
programme.desc: Jonny Caplan shows why Israel is often referred to as The Silicon Valley of the Middle East or The Start-up Nation and why it's one of the leading places to build a start-up. Dont miss the AI robots at Tel Aviv University, and other exciting tech.

programme.title: Work Dating, Coded Lego, & Robot Companions
programme.desc: Our journey continues to find the best innovators and emerging entrepreneurs worldwide. Jonny & Jessy travel across Israel to find out what it took Danny from Algobrix to make supercharged coded Lego games, and Ron and the team, to create their revolutionary employment matching app. We also meet ElliQ, the AI Robot companion designed to engage and guard the elderly.

programme.title: Did a Giant Dancing Pineapple Just Jump Into This Meeting?
programme.desc: In season 10, Marc Randolph, Kim Perrell, and Pinky Cole join a rotating team of investors in Entrepreneur Elevator Pitch. Witness unprecedented requests and a historic recall in the exciting premiere!

programme.title: Netflix Co-Founder Marc Randolph Made a Surprise Move That Stunned Investors
programme.desc: Season ten of Entrepreneur Elevator Pitch kicks off with unprecedented twists. Pitch meetings prove unpredictable, with Marc Randolph emphasizing long-term customer engagement for success. Watch as deals come alive and change in a heartbeat!

programme.title: Finale
programme.desc: Step into the electrifying atmosphere of Hero City for the grand finale of 'Meet the Drapers'! Seven dynamic startups stand on the brink of destiny, each vying for the prestigious 1 million dollar prize. As anticipation crackles in the air, the stage is set for an epic showdown of innovation, resilience, and entrepreneurial spirit.

programme.title: Denmark
programme.desc: Welcome to 'Meet the Drapers' global adventure! Venture capitalist Tim Draper leads a quest to discover billion-dollar startups worldwide. In Denmark, he teams up with Tine Thygesen and Torsten Kolind to evaluate standout startups such as Develop Diverse, Airflight, Cogo App, and Focalx.ai. Which Danish startup secures a spot in the semi-finals, and who captures the audience's hearts to stay in the competition? Join the journey of innovation and investment!

programme.title: How To Build A Fitness Empire With Clients Like Kevin Hart
programme.desc: Ron Boss Everline has made personal fitness and training his lifes work. He attended Northwest Missouri State University on a full athletic football scholarship in pursuit of his professional football dreams. This next level of athletic achievement was the obvious choice for him as he comes from a pedigree of football elites. Boss training programs have grown into the brand, Total Player LLC, an umbrella company he created to introduce luxury health and fitness.

programme.title: Building a Famous Brand with Dee Murthy
programme.desc: Dee Murthy is Co-Founder of Los Angeles based Five Four Group and Young & Reckless. Five Four/MenloClub is the leading mens fashion membership e-commerce platform with a portfolio of five brands that include: New Republic by Mark McNairy, Grand AC and Oshenta. He is also a seasoned investor and partner at Queenbridge Venture Partners and partner in popular Las Vegas shoe store, 12 AM RUN. He is a co-host with Chris Drama Pfaff in a weekly lifestyle podcast Group Chat, in addition to his business ventures.

programme.title: Has Anybody Not Seen That Product?
programme.desc: Hopeful contestants may think their ideas are fresh and exciting, but more than half will fall short of the investors standards. From 21st-century photo booths to a line of lingerie, some judges will invest, but others will leave them puzzled or unconvinced.

programme.title: Periwinkle
programme.desc: After being laid off, Cole Johnson called on his friends Jordan and Seth to start a small business. They abandoned traditional employment without hesitation and founded Periwinkle, a service-based business that cleans and organizes your garage.

programme.title: Start-Up Incubators & Ethical Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: Every start-up needs some help; incubators are a great way to get the resources you need, plus financial support. We visited TechCode, a Chinese incubator, and learned about a 30-year journey to ensure that Robots and Humans will live together in harmony.

programme.title: The Iron Dome, Reporters, & Touch Technology
programme.desc: Meet the creators of the Iron Dome Missile Defence System, and see how they evolved into Environmental Technology & Energy Saving. Meet Dov and Hezy from Snappers TV and the inspiring Gal & Gabe from Multi-Touch Technology.

programme.title: Sri Sri University
programme.desc: Tim Draper, along with humanitarian leader Sri Sri Ravi Shankar and Madan Padaki, evaluates diverse Indian startups, including Ukhi (textiles & bio-plastics from Hemp), Stellar Grid (Solar Rooftop Market solutions), BONV. (carbon-free smart aerial mobility), E-panipurii kartz (touchless operation for Panipuri vendors), and Wow Mom (healthy fast food). The suspense builds as the judges decide who advances to the semi-finals and who goes home.

programme.title: The Wedding Industry is Worth Billions – What Could a Break-Up Industry be Worth?
programme.desc: Natashas dream wedding went up in flames just before the big day. As she picked up the pieces of the breakdown of her nine year relationship, she had a realization: she was in way more need of all those items from her gift registry now than she had ever been. There was a whole potential industry that could be created to help people like her get back on their feet. And so she founded MyBreakUpRegistry.com. Through hard work and social media savvy, Natashas got the site to a solid user base.

programme.title: The #1 Mistake New Authors Make
programme.desc: Author Carissa Broadbent shares her journey from marketing to bestselling indie author, discussing creativity, productivity, publishing and building a successful career.

programme.title: Why Most Founders Can't Grow Past 25 Employees
programme.desc: Weebly co-founder David Rusenko reflects on scaling the company, confronting his own leadership challenges and the dinner with Richard Branson that changed his approach.

programme.title: How Does She Make Money if It's All Free
programme.desc: Five founders and entrepreneurs appear on the show, and all leave without securing the investments they came for. This episode features a lot of failed pitches, but there are lessons in every failure.

programme.title: There's No Crying in Baseball
programme.desc: This episode starts off with a nurse practitioner explaining her tech business. After that, an entrepreneur presents his fashion MLM as the Uber of custom tailoring. An awkward pitch about a sports business leaves its founder frustrated. Finally, the show concludes with two strong pitches, one for a video review company and one for a repair and technician marketplace.

JC visits WeWork Tel Aviv to find an exciting start-up that creates a TV scanner app to hear any audio on your phone from a TV in an airport, or train station. We also talk to Ruth about her impactful venture to help to monitor and protect us from old age.

programme.title: Futuristic Zappers, Robot Washers, & Brain Gaming

programme.desc: Abdul Karim Abdullah, AfroFuture's CEO and Co-Founder, sits down with Black Enterprise to share the journey of AfroFuture from its birth to its evolution into a global movement. programme.desc: Even when the road ahead is uphill, we are built for this journey. Everyone's favorite Peloton instructor Tunde Oyeneyin, also a New York Times' Best-selling author, will uplift us with her infectious energy and Speak truth to us about moving.

programme.desc: Hype coach and confidence activator KJ Rose will help you tap into your gifts and maximize your voice to push beyond your perceived capacity. Facilitator: Keanna “KJ Rose” Henson, Author, Artist Development & Performance Director; Founder, The Rose Effect, LLC

programme.title: Unlock the Secrets to Selling Successfully to Women
programme.desc: Whether in business settings or personal relationships, communication is a critical skill for men and women alike. For women, being genuinely heard by a man can be the difference between smooth conversations and blow-up arguments. And for men who can communicate effectively with women, it can be a game-changer in personal and professional relationships. Join Ramon Ray, ZoneofGenius.com and Sulonda Smith, founder of Crystal Clear Consultations for this powerful discussion.

programme.title: Diversifying Your Revenue Streams
programme.desc: Kathy Mason founded a real estate brokerage before expanding into construction and, most recently, into agricultural spaces with a 40-acre farm and event venue

programme.title: Don't Try to Hide Personal from Business on Social Media
programme.desc: Many business owners ask if they can post personal and business on social media. YES, it's good to share your personal life, to some degree on your business oriented social media. However, if you're trying to have something "hidden" then don't. Share things you don't want anyone to see on restricted platforms like What's App. Twitter(X) changed it's blocked user settings, to allow people to see your posts, even though you've blocked them. Other things covered on The Rundown with Ramon include: -Evaluating business idea viability -Seth Godin's writing advice on brevity -LinkedIn's AI job recruitment tools -Oura Smart Ring review -Health considerations for entrepreneurs over 40 -Hard vs. soft luggage debate -Making meaningful professional connections -Twitter/X's blocking feature update -Building startups while maintaining mental health

programme.desc: Hey everyone! Today we're diving into an eye-opening conversation with Holly Reid, CEO of The Master Playbook. Holly's on a mission to help families and business owners build lasting wealth and leave a powerful legacy. In this interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, key takeaways from our chat included: 1. Legacy building isn't just for the ultra-rich. It's about creating value that lasts beyond your lifetime. 2. Forget complex financial jargon - Holly focuses on mindset shifts to kickstart your wealth journey. 3. Resistance from family members? Holly offers tips to address concerns and highlight the positive impact of increased wealth. 4. We discuss the importance of preparing your business for unexpected events. Holly shared a personal story that really drives this point home. 5. Action steps you can take today: Adopt a "legacy builder mentality," invest in yourself and your community, and start documenting your business assets properly. Holly's company, The Master Playbook, is all about empowering the next generation to master money. Whether you're a parent or a business owner, her insights can help you create a lasting financial impact. Remember, as Holly says, "Legacy isn't built on intention alone. You have to take intentional action." So let's get out there and start building our financial legacies!

The platform is constantly evolving to provide innovative avenues for connection and collaboration. One such groundbreaking feature is LinkedIn Audio Events — a platform that allows creators to host live, interactive conversations with a global audience. To explore LinkedIn Audio’s capabilities, Ramon Ray sat down with Shameka Brathwaite, a leadership productivity expert and prominent user of this platform. Below, we explore best practices and tips on making the most of LinkedIn Audio and avoiding common pitfalls.

programme.title: Use CRM Right from the Start Says Salesforce Exec
programme.desc: Whether you’re in the beginning stages of starting a business or you’ve been at it for a while, you know how important it is to facilitate smooth and effective communications with customers. Customer relationship management (CRM) tools make keeping in touch and developing a loyal customer base easier. However, knowing which CRM tools are best for startups can be challenging for new business owners who may not yet need an enterprise-level solution. Choosing a tool that can scale with you is the best way to make the most of a CRM solution, and that’s what Salesforce Starter aims to do. Recently launched by Salesforce to support small businesses, Salesforce Starter is an all-in-one CRM app combining sales, service, and marketing capabilities. Recently, Ramon Ray had the opportunity to explore the world of Salesforce Starter with Kris Billmair, the Senior Vice President and General Manager of the self-service and growth team at Salesforce. This article offers key takeaways on how a CRM tool like Salesforce Starter can help small businesses better manage customer relationships, centralize data, and grow more efficiently.

programme.title: Episode 11: A TAILING TALE
programme.desc: Razzle Dazzle Day celebrates the uniqueness of Dazzle Land with a Surprise Dazzle. But it only happens if all the friends are together at sunset ...

programme.title: Episode 12: THE BIG CLEAN
programme.desc: Unusual Clean-up Weather is heading the way of Bommi and Friends! After the falling soap bubbles, the rain and the drying wind machines, it's time to put everything away

programme.title: Episode 13: THE GREAT RACE
programme.desc: It's the great Fazzmobile Relay Race and Maya has promised Yip that he can drive one of the Fazzmobiles. However, she reconsiders and decides to drive it herself, breaking her promise to Yip.

programme.title: Episode 1: GREETINGS FROM DAZZLE LAND
programme.desc: In the first episode, Bommi's dream comes true when her book Libro comes to life and magically transports her into Dazzle Land where she meets her life-long, pop-up book friends.

programme.title: Episode 2: SNOOGLE BERRY DELIGHT
programme.desc: Picking, sorting, juicing and baking Dazzle Land's colorful Snoogleberries can be a lot of fun, if you follow the directions. It takes teamwork and an imaginative Dazzle to sort things out again.

programme.title: Episode 3: CHEARS FOR FEAR
programme.desc: In a Dazzle Land amusement park, Bommi and her friends confront different things that they fear, such as heights and darkness. All except Rumba, why?

programme.title: Episode 4: A TACO TALE
programme.desc: On Dazzle Land Beach Day, Taco borrows Remba's beautiful Snazzle Bedazzle Shell necklace. When he accidentally loses it, he doesn't immediately tell the truth, leading to difficult situations..

programme.title: Episode 5: THE EXERT-A-TRON
programme.desc: Maya invents the Exert-A-Tron, an exercising machine that promises all the benefits of exercise without actually expending any effort. The Exert-A-Tron misses a fundamental point: exercise is fun!

programme.title: Episode 6: DAZZLE LAND ART DAY
programme.desc: DazzleLand Art Day is the perfect chance for Bommi and her friends to discover that everyone is an artist and we can all create beautiful things.

programme.title: Episode 7: BORIS' BIRTHDAY
programme.desc: After a delicious Razzle Dazzle Birthday Frazzle, it's time for Boris's birthday gifts. But it turns out that his Dazzle Land gifts are better suited for the givers than Boris

programme.title: Episode 8: RAINBOW-ZZLES AND DAZZLE
programme.desc: When Yip doesn't share his skateboard with Taco, and Remba doesn't share her secret Rainbow-zzle recipe with Maya, the friendships in Dazzle Land begin to frazzle.

programme.title: Episode 9: TRY TRY AGAIN
programme.desc: Remba believes that she can learn to the play borzzlehorn just by listening to it. Yip believes that he can learn to jump rope just by watching Taco.

programme.title: Episode 10: A LITTLE HELP FROM MY FRIENDS
programme.desc: A magical dazzle kite draws pictures in the sky, alerting Bommi and friends to others in need. In a fun sequence of adventures, everyone realizes how friendships are made stronger

programme.title: Friday After Next
programme.desc: Craig and Day-Day work as security guards at a local shopping mall on Christmas Eve. When a crooked Santa Claus robs their apartment, they must navigate holiday chaos, pursue the thief, and try to recover their stolen presents and rent money before it's too late.

programme.title: The Bachelor Weekend (The Stag)
programme.desc: An Irish groom's brother plans a hiking trip bachelor party with a no-women rule. When the groom's fiancée's brother shows up with his girlfriend, tensions arise. The weekend camping trip becomes a test of friendships, masculinity, and relationships in the wilderness.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Film noir-obsessed video store clerk Neil meets and falls for Violet, a free-spirited woman who pulls him into her world of spontaneous adventures. She stages elaborate film-like scenarios to shake up his routine life, but her extreme methods test whether their romance can survive reality.

programme.title: Two Can Play That Game
programme.desc: Corporate attorney and relationship expert Shante Smith uses her rules for romance to keep her boyfriend in line. When he threatens to stray, she employs her ten-day plan to regain control, but his best friend counters with his own dating strategies in this battle of sexes.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Best friends Sidney and Dre share a lifelong love of hip-hop music. As they navigate their careers in the music industry—she as a magazine editor, he as a record executive—they must confront whether their deep connection is just friendship or something more romantic.

programme.title: All About The Benjamins
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Bucum Jackson teams with small-time con artist Reggie Wright, the man he's been pursuing, to locate missing diamonds and a lottery ticket worth millions. The unlikely partners race against criminals in this action-comedy about money, survival, and unexpected friendship.

programme.title: 500 Days of Summer
programme.desc: Hopeless romantic Tom Hansen works at a greeting card company and falls for Summer, a woman who doesn't believe in true love. The nonlinear narrative follows 500 days of their relationship as Tom reflects on where things went wrong after she unexpectedly dumps him.

programme.title: Fruitvale Station
programme.desc: Based on the true story of Oscar Grant's last day, January 1, 2009. The 22-year-old Bay Area resident celebrates New Year's Eve with family and friends before a confrontation with police at Fruitvale BART station leads to his tragic death, sparking national outrage.

programme.title: The Great Debaters
programme.desc: Based on a true story, professor Melvin B. Tolson inspires students at historically black Wiley College to form a debate team in 1930s Texas. They challenge racial prejudice and inequality, ultimately competing against Harvard University in a groundbreaking championship match.

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Childhood friends Monica and Quincy both aspire to professional basketball careers. Over eleven years, their paths intertwine as they navigate their passionate relationship alongside their athletic ambitions, learning that love requires the same dedication and sacrifice as sports.

programme.title: Lords of Chaos
programme.desc: Based on true events, the film chronicles the rise of Norwegian black metal music scene in the early 1990s. Young musicians form bands that descend into church burnings, violence, and murder, with tragic consequences for the underground music community.

programme.title: Take This Waltz
programme.desc: Margot, a happily married woman, develops an intense attraction to her charming neighbor Daniel. She struggles between comfortable marriage and passionate desire, exploring themes of commitment, longing, and whether giving in to temptation will bring happiness or destroy everything.

programme.title: Mr. 3000
programme.desc: Aging baseball legend Stan Ross discovers that three of his 3,000 career hits were incorrectly counted. Nine years after retiring, the arrogant player returns to baseball at age 47 to reclaim his record and legacy while learning humility and what truly matters.

programme.title: Baby Boy
programme.desc: Twenty-year-old Jody lives with his mother while fathering children with two different women. When his mother's new boyfriend moves in, Jody is forced to confront his immaturity and finally grow up, facing the commitments and responsibilities of real life as an African-American man.

programme.desc: A funeral ceremony descends into chaos when a mysterious stranger arrives with a shocking secret about the deceased. Family tensions, mistaken drug consumption, and unexpected revelations turn the somber occasion into an outrageous comedy of errors filled with embarrassing disasters.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Based on a true story, Ron Stallworth becomes the first African-American detective in Colorado Springs Police Department. In the 1970s, he successfully infiltrates the local Ku Klux Klan chapter with the help of a Jewish colleague, exposing their violent plans while maintaining his cover.

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: Playboy bunny Shelley is kicked out of the mansion and becomes house mother for a struggling sorority of socially awkward girls. She teaches them about confidence and style while they help her discover there's more to life than appearance, transforming each other in the process.

programme.title: To Cut
programme.desc: A biographical documentary that tells the inspiring story of Stuart Linder, a prominent American plasticsurgeon. Once deterred by his teachers from pursuing medical practices, now one of the most sough after professionals in practice.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Unable to come to terms with the death of his brother by the hands of a police officer, Quincy is pushed to face his emotions and navigate his new reality. In doing so, he is presented with an opportunity to seek justice in an unconventional way.

programme.title: Xavier
programme.desc: A biographical documentary short that tells the story of a chance meeting of social media peronality Blake Linder and cancer warrior Xavier Mejias. This visual challenges audiences to reach for higher levels of compassion, selflessness, mentorship and gratefulness while begging the question "are you truly connecting with people on social media".

programme.title: All My Friends Are Robots
programme.desc: After one brother clicks a strange hyperlink, two siblings must battle their best friend—now transformed into a relentless humanoid—before the glitch consumes them all.

programme.title: Ashes To Ashes
programme.desc: When Xavier unexpectedly receives the ashes of his dead father in the mail, he is forced to confront a lifetime of daddy issues.

programme.title: Below Watson's
programme.desc: Beneath the charm of Watson’s Soda Fountain and Café on East Chapman Avenue in Orange, California, lies a mystery sealed in brick and shadow. Once a bustling drug store and diner during the Prohibition era, the café is said to sit above a hidden network of tunnels that have long been blocked from public view. Were these tunnels a lifeline, a smuggling route—or something far more dangerous? This documentary highlights the community that whispers about the layers of history, chasing the echoes of footsteps that may never have wanted to be found.

programme.title: Candles
programme.desc: In this short psychological thriller, a seemingly grieveing and sinister teen boy. Is his therapist an emotional anchor? Or is she someone quite sinister herself?

programme.title: Chick Bait
programme.desc: In this lighthearted comedy, a lonely, overweight man just wants to enjoy a quiet afternoon and his baskin robbins Ice cream. But his simple pleasure takes a wild turn when a mischievous dachshund waddles up, steals his sweet trea. the man tries to shoo the dog away, but fate has other plans. A charming young woman notices the adorable thief and mistakes the man for its doting owner. Suddenly thrust into an unexpected role, he finds himself sharing laughs and lunch with her, daydreaming that maybe, just maybe, this accident could lead to love. But just as the sparks begin to flicker, disaster strikes. The real owner appears, frantic and furious at finding the “lost” dog in the man’s company. A story of ice cream, mistaken identity, and a very determined little dog.

programme.title: Dream To Sell
programme.desc: A biographical documentary that tells the inspiring rags to riches story of Simon Sarradine, a prominent American with lebanese ancestry. Once a struggling boy, now the king of a motor-vehicle empire, who continues to dream bigger.

programme.title: Father Figure
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps his two children, consumed by resentment toward his ex-wife, Diana, and convinced that only he can provide them a safe home. But as his desperation grows, Richard's obsessive need for control begins to expose the monstrous reflection of his own flaws. Meanwhile, their fractured family becomes the target of the Father Figure-a sinister entity that preys on children from broken, unstable homes. When the demon abducts the children, Richard is forced to face the consequences of his destructive choices and the darker truths about himself. Now, he must confront the ultimate evil to save his children, before his mistakes doom him forever.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 002: Valentine’s Day Love, Kendrick Lamar’s Super Bowl Performance, & NBA All-Star Weekend Highlights
programme.desc: In this exciting first episode of Mic’d Up: The Podcast, hosts Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith dive into all the hottest topics of the season! From the magic of Valentine’s Day love to Kendrick Lamar’s unforgettable Super Bowl halftime performance, this episode covers it all. Plus, get the inside scoop on the NBA All-Star Weekend, the biggest highlights, and what made it so memorable. Join us for a fun and lively conversation about music, sports, and everything in between!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 003: Nike Scandal, Lakers x One Piece Collab, and LA’s Strict Nightlife Rules & Discrimination
programme.desc: In this episode of Mic’d Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith tackle some of the hottest topics in pop culture and beyond. First up: The mystery behind stolen Nikes—did Nike orchestrate the theft themselves? Then, they dive into the collaboration between the Lakers and One Piece, along with opening exclusive One Piece trading cards! The conversation heats up as they discuss the SAG Awards and the controversial nightlife rules and discrimination issues in big cities like LA. Tune in for an insightful, no-holds-barred discussion on current events and pop culture!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 004: Oscar Buzz, Pokémon Prismatic ETB Box Break, and the Mavericks' Downfall with Kyrie Irving
programme.desc: In this exciting episode of Mic'd: The Podcast Mic & Daniel dive into the latest buzz from the Oscars and what’s making headlines in Hollywood. But that’s not all—things get even more interesting when they break open a Pokémon Prismatic ETB box and explore the world of collectibles. The episode wraps up with a deep dive into the Mavericks’ recent struggles, including Kyrie Irving’s unexpected injury and what this means for the team’s future.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 005: Running the LA Marathon for Charity, Crypto Talk, NFL Trades & Japanese One Piece Cards
programme.desc: In this episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon shares his personal journey as he prepares to run the LA Marathon this Sunday for charity. He talks about the motivation and drive required to commit to such a challenge and explains how anyone can push themselves to achieve big goals, no matter the obstacles. The conversation then shifts to the world of cryptocurrency, as Michelangelo and Daniel Smith break down the latest trends and discuss NFL trades. To cap off the episode, they open some rare Japanese One Piece trading cards.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 006: Adan Castillo on Training the Paul Brothers, Motivation & Pulling a Rare Pokémon Card
programme.desc: This week on Mic’d Up: The Podcast, we welcome a special guest—celebrity boxing coach Adan Castillo, the man behind Logan Paul’s training for The Mayweather Fight and Jake Paul’s transition into pro boxing. Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith dive deep into the world of elite training, discussing the mindset, motivation, and sacrifices it takes to succeed at the highest level. Beyond the ring, the conversation expands to the importance of inner circles, overcoming struggles, and the drive to chase your goals—whether you’re a celebrity or an everyday person striving for greatness. To top it off, the guys open Pokémon cards and pull the rarest card yet!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 007: Morning Routines That Trend, CONCACAF Nations League Soccer, & Jordan 4 Bricks Review
programme.desc: This week's episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast as Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith unpack the latest trends in morning routines that are sweeping the nation. Discover tips and tricks that might revolutionize your own start to the day. Switching gears, the hosts recap the excitement from the recent CONCACAF Nations League soccer games, discussing standout moments and key plays. Plus, don't miss their exclusive review of the sneaker of the year, the Jordan 4 "Bricks" by Nigel Sylvester.

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 008: Avatar's Return, Nokia's Viral Video, Coachella Hype, NBA's Marketing Moves, NFL Rule Changes
programme.desc: Episode 008 of Mic'd Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith delve into the buzz surrounding the upcoming Avatar movie, discussing its potential impact and fan expectations. They analyze Nokia's latest music video that's taking the internet by storm and share their excitement for the approaching Coachella festival, highlighting anticipated performances and trends. The conversation shifts to the NBA, where they examine recent player suspensions and debate whether marketing strategies are influencing league decisions more than ever. They also unpack the NFL's new rule changes for 2025, exploring how adjustments to overtime and kickoff rules could affect game dynamics and betting landscapes . To top it all off, the hosts open a pack of Dragon Ball Z trading cards, aiming for those elusive God Rare cards, and discuss the thrill of collecting and the value of rare finds .

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 009: Coachella Special With The Girls! Festival Drama, Prismatic Evolutions & Dire Wolves Return?
programme.desc: Get festival-ready with this special Coachella episode of Mic'd Up: The Podcast! Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith are joined by three special guests who reveal all the drama, stress, and secrets behind getting Coachella-ready. The excitement continues as they open a Pokémon Prismatic Evolutions box, letting the girls test their luck and pull some heat. Michelangelo also shares highlights from an unforgettable weekend with El Cristiano Tequila. Plus, they dive into the astonishing news of scientists bringing back an extinct species—the Dire Wolf. Don't miss this episode packed with festival tips, rare Pokémon cards, wild stories, and mind-blowing science news!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 010: Coachella Recap, WNBA Draft Highlights, Tariffs Shaking Fashion, True Religion Denim
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith recap Michelangelo’s unforgettable Coachella experience—covering standout performances, behind-the-scenes moments, and festival vibes. They dive into the highlights from the recent WNBA Draft and discuss the future of women's basketball. With tariffs impacting fashion and consumer products, the hosts explore what this means for your favorite brands and trends. Michelangelo showcases his fresh pair of True Religion jeans and shares his personal take on fashion’s latest moves. Plus, could dinosaurs really be making a comeback?

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 011: Sinners, Ryan Coogler's Huge Deal, Oscar Rule Changes, Shannon Sharpe’s Drama & NBA Playoffs!
programme.desc: Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith break down the buzz around the upcoming movie Sinners, and dive into director Ryan Coogler’s groundbreaking deal that's changing the Hollywood landscape. They discuss the Oscars' new rules requiring voters to watch every nominated movie, potentially reshaping award season forever. The conversation heats up when addressing Shannon Sharpe’s lawsuit drama, exploring how legal situations differ between wealthy and not-so-wealthy relationships. In "Smitty’s Corner," Daniel tackles the latest highlights from the NBA Playoffs. Michelangelo also showcases El Cristiano Mezcal’s stunning bottle and introduces listeners to Disney's Labubus.
